benchmarkConcurrencyScope: All campaign hosts: jaro-dev7 coordinator plus jaro-dev8 and jaro-dev9. At most one benchmark globally; remote hosts are never authorized to benchmark.
remoteInitialScope: Whole-finding helpers, never split source versions between hosts. Each node prepares both Original and observed Default in separate private graphs on that same physical node; OpenAPI on dev8, MVC on dev9. Exact repo-local SDK/package restore and unchanged prerequisite rebuilds only. No machine-wide install, configuration edit, prototype, test runner, timing or publication.
remoteBuildTestScopeForTiming: Only untimed tasks on physically separate hosts. They are optional and do not gate coordinator timing; all owned builds/tests on the coordinator box must still be quiescent.
workerBuildTestScope: Untimed Original/current-default producer validation only in the worker's dedicated source/output graphs. Preserve completed Original evidence and outputs. No shipping/config edits, candidate implementations, benchmarks, shared coordinator/default outputs, publishing or ledger writes. Every owned build/test must stop before any timing.

Driver runs native wrappers synchronously; wrapper fully awaits each fresh host and both fresh client children/streams. Every image file and exact selected runtime inputs rehashed. externalProcessBoundary: One global Windows mutex coordinates compliant gateways across processes/sessions; a persistent exclusive lease fails closed on failure/abandonment.
